q49CorrectedQuestion:

Dim X, Y As Integer
Dim A(6) As Integer
For X = 1 To 6
    A(1) = 1
    A(X) = 0
    For Y = X - 1 To 2 Step -1
        A(Y) = A(Y - 1) + A(Y)
    Next Y
Next X
